approval.approved_by: Alvin K. Tay (project owner), authorised in session 2026-08-04
approval.d8_reference: No instrument text is stored or released. The mapping records only NHANES variable names (DPQ010-DPQ090), category codes (0-3) and administrative codes (7, 9), which are metadata, not the copyrighted PHQ-9 item wording. The NCHS codebook PDF is excluded from the repository. Enforced by test: test_no_copyrighted_item_text_in_the_mapping.
approval.d9_reference: Discharged by the NHANES public-use release terms. CDC/NCHS publishes these files after disclosure control expressly for secondary analysis; no additional consent instrument is required for analysis of the public-use file. Re-identification is prohibited by those terms and is not attempted. Access tier: public_use.
approval.notes: Scope: role=pipeline_development on NHANES 2015-2016 DPQ_I only. Does NOT extend to DPQ_J (reserved untouched zero-shot validation), to any restricted dataset, or to training, fine-tuning, recalibration or threshold modification, all of which remain false in permissions and are rejected by the schema.

attribution: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS). National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey Data, 2015-2016. Hyattsville, MD: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.
notes: Role is pipeline_development: this dataset exists to exercise and debug the ingestion and evaluation pipeline. Results from it are NOT a zero-shot transfer claim, and no gate criterion may be assessed on it.
publication_use_status: NHANES public-use data carry no restriction on analysis or publication; NCHS asks that the data be cited and that no attempt be made to re-identify respondents. PHQ-9 item TEXT is copyrighted and is not reproduced here or in any template (D8 governs; see instrument licensing).
raw_data_location: data/public/DPQ_I.xpt (gitignored; stays outside the repository index)

reserved_datasets.nhanes_2017_2018_dpq_j: RESERVED as untouched zero-shot validation data. Must not be opened, profiled, converted or analysed during pipeline development: a dataset used for schema or pipeline development cannot also be the untouched transfer test.

source: CDC/NCHS public-use National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, 2015-2016 cycle, questionnaire file DPQ_I
